title: Quantifying the Impact of Chronic Ischemic Injury on Clinical Outcomes in Acute Stroke With Machine Learning
summary: Automated lesion analysis and machine learning quantified how chronic ischemic injury relates to outcomes after acute stroke in a 1,704-scan clinical cohort.
